integrity.independence: Self-review only; no independent external review or audit.
integrity.method: Exact integer unit cancellations from exhaustive simplicial chains; exact finite-field eigenspace ranks; enumerated graph automorphisms. No prior numerical output imported.

scientific_limitations: The complete automorphism action is determined only on the order-three torsion subgroup; for the rational third homology, only antipodal even/odd dimensions are determined. No full rational irreducible decomposition, integral free lattice, or family theorem is claimed. Equivalent unindexed prior results remain a possibility.
title: Antipodal symmetry distinguishes the free and three-torsion homology of the icosahedral matching complex
